drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile

tutorial.drawArea: Draw one card from the stock or discard pile.
tutorial.playerHand: Your hand (5 cards). Build melds — 3+ of a rank, or 3+ in a suit run.
tutorial.discardButton: Discard one card you don't need.
tutorial.challengeButton: Challenge when your remaining points are five or less. Meld or sapaw before discarding when useful.
tutorial.resetButton: Reset to start a new game.

frontendHint.tongitsTakeDiscard: Taking that card completes a meld and lowers your remaining points
frontendHint.tongitsDrawStock: The discard does not meld — draw from the stock
frontendHint.tongitsChallenge: Your remaining points are five or fewer — you can challenge
frontendHint.tongitsDiscardHeavy: Discard the card that leaves the fewest remaining points
